source: Copernicus GLO-30 Public DSM, AWS COG, 2021 release
local_axes: x east, y north, z up; DSM heights still absolute EGM2008
smoothed_dsm_method: Periodic Gaussian smoothing, sigma=40 metres. Indicative modelling aid only; not ground/road reconstruction.
attribution_modified: produced using Copernicus WorldDEM-30 © DLR e.V. 2010-2014 and © Airbus Defence and Space GmbH 2014-2018 provided under COPERNICUS by the European Union and ESA; all rights reserved
caveats: Digital SURFACE model: may measure roofs, tree canopies and embankments rather than road level.
Approx. 20×31 metre sample spacing here; not appropriate for exact road width, banking, kerbs, potholes or railway-crossing ramp profiles.
Source base observations are mostly from 2011–2015, with gap-fill from other DEMs; not a current-condition survey.
Sampling every 10 metres is interpolation only, not newly measured detail.
Global product accuracy specs (<4 m absolute vertical error, LE90) are not local road accuracy guarantees.
Smoothing makes a usable indicative profile but cannot remove DSM bias reliably. Road surface still requires human reference checks.
